git add crates/elephc-builtin-contract && git commit -m "test(contract): the three surface-count assertions learn the ten builtins this branch adds

catalog_is_valid_and_complete_for_all_contract_surfaces, every_contract_has_a
_backend_support_record and every_eval_binding_has_a_documented_execution_route
pin exact counts (contracts 544, eval/aot registry 474/530, interpreter
adapters 453). The merge's ten new catalog entries (str_getcsv, fputs, the
socket_* aliases, diskfreespace, set_file_buffer, stream_register_wrapper,
stream_context_set_options) moved every one of them by ten; the support and
execution derivations were already correct, so only the expected counts
change. Red on all three CI platforms in run 31805290178 (6835/6838), green
locally at 15/15 after.

The earlier local run that reported '0 passed; 0 filtered' for this crate was
the test harness compiling without running — a tail-truncated verdict, exactly
the trap the memory warns about." 2>&1 | tail -1 && git push fork HEAD:refs/heads/feat/streams-csv-signatures --force-with-lease=refs/heads/feat/streams-csv-signatures:034ac079366a01c81f8ada37e6493e11e33ef94d 2>&1 | tail -1: 2 files changed, 4 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-) error: failed to push some refs to 'github.com:Guikingone/elephc.git'
